input.preprocessing: centre-crop to at most 4:3, then 5 views (whole + 4 corner crops at 80%); each resized to 256 (area) then 224 (bilinear), no normalisation

output: calibrated probabilities, softmax(logits / temperature), same order as labels

validation.accuracy_when_answered: 0.949 (5 views, all agree, mean >= 0.85; validation set)

test_set: not run yet - reserved for the final model

dataset.name: RiceLeafDiseaseBD v3
dataset.citation: Munna, M. M. H. et al. (2026), RiceLeafDiseaseBD, Mendeley Data, V3, doi: 10.17632/86s4jzj2m4.3

limitations: Only 6 classes; other diseases or pests are forced into one of them.
Photos from Gazipur only, one season (Apr-May 2025), BRRI dhan28/29.
Blast, Brown spot and Leaf smut are often confused (small lesions).
Some Sheath blight and Leaf smut photos were predicted Healthy.
Not validated on real field photos outside the dataset.

decision.reason: a 16:9 internet blast photo stretched to a square was predicted Sheath blight 0.97; views disagreed
decision.threshold_reason: 0.85 was >=95% correct on validation but only 80.5% on photos from an unseen source (Dhan-Shomadhan, 883 photos); at 0.95 confident answers were 93.9% correct there, answering 11%. That set has now informed this choice, so it is no longer a clean test - next check must be real farmer photos.

unseen_source_test.note: v0.2 (more web data) was worse here: 23.6% - learned white background as a disease cue; not shipped
